A '''vibro-stake''' was a type of [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee]] [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroweapon]].<ref name="Gamer1">{{GamerCite|1|Fair Prey}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The vibro-stake was mentioned in "[[Fair Prey]]," a short story written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and published in the [[Star Wars Gamer 1|first issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine<ref name="Gamer1" /> in [[November]] [[2000]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars Gamer Special Edition]]''</ref>
